title: oiwqi-seasonal-ml: additive irrigation water-quality index, seasonal machine-learning surrogates and SHAP
description: Python code to compute an additive irrigation water-quality index from groundwater chemistry, train machine-learning surrogates of the index for several hydrological phases, validate them with leave-one-out and nested cross-validation, and explain them with SHAP. Runs end to end on a synthetic dataset.
